name: Cynthia Vaclav Kynthia
original_name: シンシア・バーツラフ・キュンティア
source:
The White Princess.
A princess with the innocence and innocence of a child.
She refers to herself using the pronoun "watashi."
She is the current divine child, and Cynthia's "White Age" has already lasted for 300 years.
She calls the protagonist "Big Brother."

[Translated and edited a little from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040202001505/http://www.cherrysoft.co.jp/cherrysoft/kyrie.htm]the official site[/url]]
